title: Putin says at Valdai that Russia threatens no one and will not attack anyone 'in 2029, 2030 or 2050'
summary: Speaking at the Valdai Discussion Club plenary, Putin says Russia does not plan to attack anyone but would respond if it faced aggression.

title: Pakistan's FM Ishaq Dar says Mecca pact members will weigh an Iranian idea of political engagement with the Houthis instead of military action
summary: Reuters reports Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar told a news conference that Iran suggested engaging the Houthis politically as an alternative to "kinetic action" and that Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan would decide next steps at an emergency meeting in Riyadh.

title: North Korea's KCNA says Kim Jong Un oversaw an intermediate-range hypersonic missile launch that hit a target about 1,000 km away
summary: KCNA said the launch from eastern North Korea trained missile units and tested the mobility of deterrent forces, and reported Kim as saying the nuclear deterrent policy would not change.

title: Philippines says a Chinese J-16 made unsafe approaches to a Philippine Cessna near Scarborough Shoal and Chinese coast guard ships blocked a patrol
summary: Manila said the fighter's repeated approaches were unsafe and coercive, and that China Coast Guard ships and a helicopter blocked a Philippine coast guard pursuit of suspected dynamite fishing near Thitu Island and Subi Reef.

title: Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council chairman Rashad al-Alimi announces a military operation to retake Houthi-held areas, CGTN reports
summary: CGTN reports al-Alimi announced the operation on October 4 and a government spokesman said forces had secured the Bab al-Mandab Strait, while Houthi sources quoted by Al-Masirah denied government gains.

title: Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan agree on rapid deployment of Turkish and Pakistani forces to Saudi Arabia under the Mecca defence pact
summary: CGTN reports a joint statement carried by the Saudi Ministry of Defense after an emergency committee meeting in Riyadh said Pakistan and Türkiye would provide forces and ensure their rapid deployment, after the three states condemned continued attacks on Saudi cities and infrastructure.

title: Qatar's foreign ministry says its US-Iran mediation is ongoing, with messages being exchanged between Washington and Tehran
summary: Qatar Tribune reports ministry official Ibrahim bin Sultan Al Hashmi told the weekly briefing that Qatar is passing messages with the aim of progress that can serve as a basis for further talks and is open to receiving an Iranian delegation.

title: Saudi cabinet says the Houthis chose "military escalation" over peace and backs moving to practical implementation of Mecca pact defence obligations
summary: Asharq, citing SPA, reports the cabinet chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman affirmed full support for Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council and praised the alliance's agreement on an "immediate move to practical implementation of joint defense obligations".

title: Russia's Defence Ministry says it downed 868 Ukrainian drones overnight, many aimed at Moscow
summary: Russia's Defence Ministry says 868 Ukrainian drones were downed over 12 regions, Crimea and the Sea of Azov between the evening of 5 October and the morning of 6 October, and Moscow region governor Vorobyov reports two dead and nine injured.

title: South Korea's presidential office says the country made its first test launch of a domestically developed hypersonic glide vehicle
summary: Senior presidential spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said the vehicle, launched at the Agency for Defense Development's Anheung test centre and observed by President Lee Jae-myung, hit its designated target point.

title: Trump says the US "will not be attacking Iran" before the November 3 midterm elections, while the blockade stays "in full force"
summary: The National News Desk reports President Trump made the pledge in a social media post, as Iran's FM Araghchi said Tehran had received the White House response to its seven-day plan and would reply within days.

title: UK sanctions Russian oil firms Zarubezhneft and INK Capital, 12 tankers and crypto platforms, UK Foreign Office says
summary: The UK added 38 entries to its Russia sanctions list: two oil companies, 12 tankers it places in Russia's shadow fleet, three crypto exchanges, two payment platforms and 17 suppliers it links to missile and drone production.

title: Taiwan's MND says 19 PLA aircraft sorties, 13 crossing the median line, joined a 'joint combat readiness patrol' on the eve of National Day
summary: The ministry said J-16, Su-30, JH-7 and KJ-500 aircraft operated alongside PLA warships from 8:52 a.m. and that it dispatched aircraft, ships and shore-based missile systems in response.

title: US Treasury issues licence allowing Russian-origin diesel transactions until April 2027, easing part of its Russia sanctions
summary: OFAC General License 135 authorises the sale, delivery and import of Russian-origin diesel through 7 April 2027, issued the same day President Trump said the US had reached a deal with Russia to release 300,000 tons of diesel, Clyde & Co reports.

title: China's Defence Ministry says the PLA will work with the US military to implement the leaders' consensus and strengthen dialogue
summary: Spokesperson Chen Xi said, after Xi Jinping's state visit to the US, that head-of-state diplomacy is the anchor of China-US relations and guides military ties, including managing differences.

title: China's Defence Ministry says Japan is accelerating 'remilitarisation' and urges it to completely sever ties with militarism
summary: Spokesperson Chen Xi criticised Prime Minister Takaichi's plan to revise Japan's three security documents by year-end and reports that nuclear-powered submarines may be considered.

title: Taiwan's President Lai says Taiwan 'cherishes peace' and seeks dialogue on parity and dignity, but will not give up its freedom
summary: In his National Day speech, Lai said stronger defences are meant to deter war rather than provoke China and welcomed US-China efforts to manage their rivalry through dialogue.

title: South Korea's military says North Korea fired several ballistic missiles of different types from near Pyongyang, some flying over 900 km
summary: Japan's Defence Ministry said the missiles likely fell outside Japan's EEZ, and a South Korean military official linked the launch to Seoul's first successful hypersonic missile test.

title: EU lists 826 companies and 743 executives tied to Russia's military industry in its largest single round of designations
summary: The EU Council froze assets and banned travel for 1,569 Russian firms and executives plus 77 people linked to State Duma elections held in parts of Ukraine under Russian control, Morgan Lewis reports.

title: NATO commander Grynkewich warns the alliance would destroy 'anything and everything' involved in an attack on it
summary: At the Warsaw Security Forum, NATO's Supreme Allied Commander Europe Gen. Alexus Grynkewich says NATO is defensive but would strike whatever supports and controls an attacking force, remarks AP says were aimed at Moscow.

title: US President Trump says he may meet North Korea's Kim Jong Un during his Asia trip next month
summary: Speaking to reporters as he left the White House, Trump said he gets along with Kim, ahead of scheduled stops at the ASEAN summit in the Philippines and APEC in Shenzhen in November.

title: NATO starts annual Steadfast Noon nuclear deterrence exercise in Italy with 17 nations, which it calls routine
summary: NATO says the long-planned exercise uses no live weapons and is not directed at any country, and Secretary General Mark Rutte called NATO a defensive alliance.

title: IRGC says a container ship sank after hitting a naval mine while crossing the Strait of Hormuz by a route Tehran calls unauthorized
summary: Shafaq News reports the IRGC statement alongside maritime security data showing at least 10 vessels attacked in or near the strait from October 11, the highest three-day total since the war began on February 28.

title: France says it backs an energy truce and is preparing peace talks for when all parties negotiate in good faith, foreign ministry says
summary: The French foreign ministry spokesperson said France supports an energy truce if both sides agree, and said that in France's view Russia is not yet ready to take a step toward peace.
srcName: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs

title: India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh says any future terrorist act originating from Pakistan would draw an even "stronger response"
summary: PTI reports Singh told a defence conclave in Delhi that Operation Sindoor, the Balakot airstrikes and the surgical strikes showed a shift in how India responds.

title: EU leaders urge Russia to accept a full, unconditional and immediate ceasefire, European Council conclusions say
summary: The European Council said peace cannot be decided without Ukraine, welcomed the release of EUR 6.6 billion from the European Peace Facility and regretted the US decision to temporarily lift sanctions on Russian diesel.

title: Pakistan's Foreign Office calls Rajnath Singh's remarks "reckless" and "provocative" and says Pakistan is ready to defend its sovereignty
summary: PTI reports FO spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan said Pakistan rejects and condemns the remarks and that its restraint should not be read as weakness.

title: Trump signs order waiving sanctions and duties on Russia under the Graham Act before it takes effect
summary: Trump signs an executive order waiving the Graham Act's sanctions on Russian officials, oligarchs and financial institutions two days before the law took effect, certifying to Congress that the waiver serves US national interests.

title: Netanyahu unveils a national security doctrine saying Israel must prevent the enemy's "first blow" and can act on Iran without US approval
summary: Israel Hayom reports Netanyahu named a nuclear-armed Iran as Israel's greatest threat, described a shift toward preemptive action and said "we must bring this regime down once and for all".

title: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia struck with ballistic and cruise missiles and 269 drones; Kyiv reports 1 dead, 8 injured
summary: Ukraine's Air Force says 243 drones and four missiles were downed, while Russia's Defence Ministry says it hit a data centre, a logistics hub and defence-industry sites in and around Kyiv.

title: Iran's FM Araghchi says indirect talks with the US via Pakistan and Qatar continue and Hormuz would fully reopen on day six of Iran's plan
summary: Iran International reports Araghchi told Iraq's Al-Ikhbariya that Washington does not disagree with Iran's seven-day plan but wants added clauses, and that Iran asks the US to meet its commitments under the Islamabad memorandum.

title: IRGC says two tankers were set ablaze and halted in the Strait of Hormuz, Tasnim reports
summary: Tasnim reports, citing the IRGC, that two tankers were set on fire and stopped in the strait; ship names and flags were not given in the available report.

title: NATO says allies are sending more patrol aircraft, radars and drones to the Black Sea after drone attacks on merchant ships
summary: NATO spokesman Col. Martin O'Donnell said the aim is more sensors and data sharing; NATO, Bulgaria and Romania have not attributed the attacks and the Kremlin denies involvement, Al Jazeera reports.

title: Zelensky says he held talks in Oslo with US envoy Witkoff, with Norway's Store and Finland's Stubb taking part
summary: Zelensky says the Oslo talks ran at several levels, including a wider round with UK, French and Italian security advisers and the European Commission president's chief of staff.

title: US envoy Witkoff meets Zelensky in Oslo on ending the war; Rubio calls the meeting positive, Reuters reports
summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Witkoff would share the results of the Oslo meeting with Russia, Reuters reports.

title: EU's Kallas proposes new oil, shadow-fleet and banking listings for 22nd sanctions package, TASS reports
summary: Speaking in the European Parliament, EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas argued for new restrictions on Russian oil despite Europe's energy crisis; the package needs unanimity and has no adoption date, TASS reports.

title: Kremlin aide Ushakov says after Putin-Witkoff talks that Russia is ready to resume talks with the US and Ukraine in early November
summary: Ushakov says Russia is ready to resume Russia-US-Ukraine talks in the first half of November, while calling the Oslo proposals Witkoff presented an insufficient basis for agreement.

title: Netanyahu says Iran is "once again trying to develop its weapons of death"; Defense Minister Katz says "If Iran attacks Israel, Iran will burn"
summary: The Times of Israel reports both spoke at an IDF officers' graduation ceremony at the Bahad 1 base in southern Israel.

title: US envoy Witkoff holds talks of over three hours with Putin in St Petersburg, saying Oslo talks laid groundwork for ending the conflict, BFM reports
summary: BFM reports Witkoff said he hoped to discuss next steps toward a settlement, and Izvestia reports Washington invited Moscow to resume trilateral talks with Ukraine.

title: Zelensky says Ukraine and Russia exchanged prisoners in a 270-for-270 swap
summary: Zelensky and Ukraine's Coordination Headquarters say 270 Ukrainians, including 38 officers and nine civilians, returned home, and ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets calls the exchange historic.

title: White House says First Lady Melania Trump brokered a localised Russia-Ukraine ceasefire in Oleshky
summary: The White House says she worked with Russian and Ukrainian leaders on the terms of a local ceasefire in the Russian-controlled town of Oleshky, Kherson region, to allow aid deliveries and evacuations.

title: Kremlin says resuming trilateral talks with the US and Ukraine implies no limits on combat operations
summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov says the decision to resume trilateral talks does not imply any restrictions on combat operations and that a very serious conversation on territory lies ahead.

title: Finland's Stubb and Norway's Store hold a 90-minute call with Putin and say they stressed de-escalation
summary: Stubb says ending the war requires direct discussions and that allies were consulted, while the Kremlin readout says a lasting peace requires Russia's legitimate interests to be taken into account.

title: Russia's Defence Ministry says it halted shelling toward Kherson for a humanitarian operation in Oleshky
summary: Russia's Defence Ministry says the local ceasefire took effect at 04:00 Moscow time on 27 October, and Ukraine's chief negotiator Dmytro Lubinets confirmed the start, Reuters reports.

title: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia launched 2 ballistic missiles and 280 drones overnight, mainly at Kyiv
summary: Ukraine's Air Force says 257 targets were downed, and Kyiv authorities report one dead, 15 injured and the Southern Bridge damaged and closed.

title: South Korea's Unification Minister urges North Korea to accept Seoul's proposed military talks on the demarcation line
summary: In an address read for him at a DMZ peace forum, Chung Dong-young said the talks should align positions on the MDL, restore military communication lines and prevent accidental clashes, warning that hardline standoffs raise the risk of crisis.

title: Zelensky says Russia appears serious about trilateral technical talks in Abu Dhabi in November
summary: Zelensky says the planned Abu Dhabi agenda covers first de-escalation steps in energy and at sea, a prisoner exchange and Ukraine's security priorities, with the aim of ending the war.
